punchline: Ray Kroc walked into a burger stand to sell a milkshake machine and saw that the stand's routine was the real product.
thirty_sec: A 52-year-old milkshake machine salesman walks into a burger stand in San Bernardino. High school kids are turning out identical burgers, fast and cheap, like a Swiss watch. Ray Kroc talks the two brothers into letting him franchise the method. Michael Gerber's take: the hamburger was never Kroc's product. The business that worked without him was.
